reason: Move beyond source repo capacity estimates to exact pinned file+support paths per backend for three format-duplicated large source models; preserve distinct specialized learned weights and avoid unnecessary duplicate representations.

outstanding_gates: Verify exact user backend and hardware incl. RAM/VRAM, OS, kernel ABI, quant zero-point format, TP, batch, context and stable runtime versions.
For Mistral: distinguish HF config.json vs native params.json and pin loader (SGLang format-detection fix). Test output equivalence if converting.
For GPT-OSS: choose original/ reference or HF converted; full OpenAI code commit and prompt format needed. Metal file only with Apple CPU/GPU.
For FLUX2 gated model: user-authorized Gated terms acceptance, full hashes, Diffusers/runtime and dependencies required; no download.
Measure actual formatted filesystem free bytes and staging and check SHA-reuse to bound incremental storage.
Do not mirror whole repo nor assume author benchmark results transfer to every quant backend.
